name: Anticipation
description: Attempt to Jump to the top of the initiative order at the cost of 1 action. Awareness Check 25 required. The action is spent even if the attempt is failed.

name: Awakened Focus
description: You can cure yourself of fear and paralysis by passing an instant Inner focus check (1 action) .

name: Bait and Bail
description: Temporarily escape combat. Spend one action moving up to 10 Feet out of the combat. Pass a Dexterity Check 21 OR Awareness Check 21 to disengage without giving attacks of opportunity. Costs 1 action if successful or not. Combatants who have actions left at the end of the round may use them to re-engage before the combat phase.

name: Bodybuilding
description:
Rank 1: +1 on Strength Checks, Rank 2: +2 on Strength Checks, Rank 3: +1 Strength attribute,
Rank 4: +3 on Strength Checks, Rank 5: +4 on Strength Checks, Rank 6: +2 Strength attribute (total). 
Note: With 6 ranks this will increase your Strength by two, and give you a further +4 which does not apply to any combat rolls, but which does apply to Strength checks such as forcing open a locked door.
No more than 40 points can be spent on this skill during any given level.

name: Conditioning
description:
Rank 1: +1 on Constitution Checks, Rank 2: +2 on Constitution Checks, and heal an extra Hit Point every day. Rank 3: +1 Constitution attribute
Rank 4: +3 on Constitution Checks, Rank 5: +4 on Constitution Checks,and heal a second extra Hit Point every day. Rank 6: +2 Constitution attribute (total)
No more than 40 points can be spent on this skill during any given level.
Note: With 6 ranks this will increase your Constitution by two, and give you a further +4 which does not increase your hit points, but which does apply to Constitution checks such as resisting poison.

name: Desperate Evasion
description: Special Attack: Forgo your combat roll, automatically losing with a Margin of Victory of 3.

name: Enlightened Focus
description:
You can cure yourself of fear and paralysis by passing an instant Inner focus check (1 action) .
You can cure yourself of disease and poison by raising your Constitution with Inner Focus. You can rid yourself of Charm and Curse effects by raising your WP with Inner Focus, even if the effect would normally stop you from attempting to remove it.
All of these require a successful skill roll.

name: Fend Off
description: Special attack. Give up any chance of a damage roll to try and keep yourself safe.  +8 on the combat roll and +8 Evasion. Total Evasion can never exceed 20. If you lose the Margin of Victory is reduced by 50%.

name: Guardian
description: Normally a fighter can prevent any enemies from getting past a 5 Foot wide area. Increase this by +1ft /rank.

name: Hardened Resolve
description:
Rank 1: +1 on Willpower Checks, Rank 2: +2 on Willpower Checks Rank 3: +1 Willpower attribute.
Rank 4: +3 on Willpower Checks, Rank 5: +4 on Willpower Checks Rank 6: +2 Willpower attribute.
Note: With 6 ranks this will increase your Willpower by two, and give you a further +4 which does not apply to any combat rolls, but which does apply to Willpower checks such as resisting fear.
No more than 40 points can be spent on this skill during any given level.

name: Initiative
description: +1 Initiative/Rank.

name: Languages
description: Speak another language. (first is free)

name: Lengthened Stride
description: Double your movement speed when you have been running at your maximum speed for the two previous actions. Stacks with Alacrity. Changing direction or stopping suddenly becomes difficult unless unfettered.

name: Observation Training
description:
Rank 1: +1 on Awareness Checks, Rank 2: +2 on Awareness Checks, +1 Evasion, Rank 3: +1 Awareness attribute
Rank 4: +3 on Awareness Checks, Rank 5: +4 on Awareness Checks, +2 Evasion, Rank 6: +2 Awareness attribute
Note: With 6 ranks this will increase your Awareness by two, and give you a further +4 which does not apply to any combat rolls, but which does apply to Awareness checks such as finding secret doors. All pluses above are total.
No more than 40 points can be spent on this skill during any given level.

name: Persuasion
description:
Rank 1: +1 on Charisma Checks, Rank 2: +2 on Charisma Checks, Rank 3: +1 Charisma attribute
Rank 4: +3 on Charisma Checks, Rank 5: +4 on Charisma Checks, Rank 6: +2 Charisma attribute
Note: With 6 ranks this will increase your Charisma by two, and give you a further +4 which does not apply to any combat rolls, but which does apply to Charisma checks such as a guard's reaction to you.
No more than 20 points can be spent on this skill during any given level.

name: Poised Patience
description: Hold your turn without action penalty.

name: Practice makes Perfect
description: Become immune to Fumbles. (Still a miss)

name: Reading & Writing
description: Read and Write one language/rank

name: Reflex Training
description:
Rank 1: +1 on Dexterity Checks, Rank 2: +2 on Dexterity Checks, +1 Initiative, Rank 3: +1 Dexterity attribute,
Rank 4: +3 on Dexterity Checks, Rank 5: +4 on Dexterity Checks, +2 Initiative, Rank 6: +2 Dexterity attribute. 
Note: With 6 ranks this will increase your Dexterity by two, and give you a further +4 which does not apply to any combat rolls, but which does apply to Dexterity Checks such as jumping over obstacles. All pluses above are total. 
No more than 40 points can be spent on this skill during any given level.

name: Resilience
description: Increase your hit points in every body section by 1/rank.

name: Slow Fall
description: If you are within 8 Feet of a wall or surface learn to slow your fall to a survivable speed. Requires a Dexterity Check 30 to emerge unscathed, 25 to limit the damage to 1d6, and 20 to limit the damage to 2d6.

name: The search for Enlightenment
description: . +1 to all attribute check bonuses/rank . This does not raise any of your attributes.

name: Tireless
description: Increase your weight allowance by 50%.

name: Zen in Motion
description:
Learn to be fully present and to act during an emergence without hesitation or doubt. In any round you choose, roll a Willpower or Awareness Check 25. If you pass you gain one extra action that turn. No penalties for failure. 
No more than 10 points can be spent on this skill during any given level.
